title: Batch launch lines on a refused carry, and an exact assertion in the credential-refresh test
outcome: The member lines saying a batch gate's launch fence could not be read, or was cut short, are given only when the gate's carry was accepted (engram_carry_check returned no refusal), since a refused gate binds nothing and its own line tells the holder. credentials_engram_refuses_are_refreshed_before_the_bind_is_sent_again asserts the exact post-refusal state (rebind_required set and one session_bind attempted) instead of `rebound || marked`.
acceptance: Batch launch lines on a refused carry, and an exact assertion in the credential-refresh test is done
